sortieMusters.line: ⚔️ SORTIE — Mlungisi, Hang take up arms and a day's rations (4,000 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.

⚔️ SORTIE — Hang, Jesse, Rosa take up arms and a day's rations (6,046 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
